installer.welcome.title: Welcome to Keymaster
installer.welcome.text:
Keymaster removes green screens with CorridorKey 2.0. This installer sets up everything it needs and adds Keymaster to the programs you have.

It downloads about 12 GB (Python, PyTorch and the models), so it can take a while. You need an NVIDIA graphics card.
installer.components.text: Pick what to install. Programs found on this computer are already selected.
installer.component.core.desc: The keyer itself: Python, PyTorch and the CorridorKey models, about 12 GB.
installer.component.app.desc: A desktop app that keys clips without any other program.
installer.component.blender.desc: The Keymaster panel in Blender's Video Sequencer, for every Blender 5 found on this computer.
installer.component.openfx.desc: The Keymaster effect for DaVinci Resolve, Nuke and other OpenFX programs. Windows asks for administrator rights to copy it to the shared plugin folder.
installer.component.adobe.desc: The Keymaster panel for After Effects and Premiere Pro.
installer.gpu.missing: No NVIDIA graphics card or driver was found. Keymaster needs one to key footage. You can install it anyway and add the card or driver later.
installer.step.ffmpeg_system: Using the ffmpeg already on this computer: {path}
installer.step.core: Installing Python, PyTorch and the CorridorKey models. This downloads about 12 GB and can take a long time...
installer.step.adobe: Adding the panel to After Effects and Premiere Pro...
installer.mode.skip_core: Test mode: skipping Python, PyTorch and the model downloads.
installer.openfx.skipped: The OpenFX plugin was not copied because that needs administrator rights. To add it later, run: {command}
installer.openfx.failed: The OpenFX plugin could not be copied to {dir}. Run the installer again and allow the administrator prompt.
installer.blender.none: No Blender 5 was found, so the Blender panel was skipped.
installer.blender.failed: Keymaster could not be added to Blender {version}.
installer.error.download: A download failed. Check your internet connection and run the installer again.
installer.error.checksum: A downloaded file did not match its expected checksum, so it was not used. Run the installer again, and report it if it keeps happening.
installer.error.core: The Keymaster core could not be installed. Check your internet connection and that you have about 15 GB free, then run the installer again. The details are in {log}.
installer.error.app: The standalone app could not be installed. The details are in {log}.
installer.error.disk: Only {free} GB are free in {dir}. Keymaster needs about 15 GB.
installer.error.arch: Keymaster needs a 64-bit Intel or AMD (x86-64) computer.
installer.error.no_download_tool: curl or wget is needed to download files. Install one and run the installer again.
installer.error.bad_component: Unknown component: {name}. Use any of core, app, blender, openfx.
installer.error.bad_option: Unknown option: {name}. Run with --help to see the options.
installer.done.problems: Keymaster is installed, but the setup check found problems: {checks}. The lines above say what to fix.
installer.finish.title: Keymaster is installed
installer.finish.ok: Everything is ready. Open Keymaster from the Start menu, or use the Keymaster panel in your programs after restarting them.
installer.finish.problems: Keymaster is installed, but the setup check found problems. The end of the install log says what to fix, and the Setup check in any Keymaster panel shows it too.
installer.next.app: Start the app from your applications menu or with: {command}
installer.next.blender: In Blender, open the Video Sequencer sidebar (N) and the Keymaster tab.
installer.next.openfx: Restart DaVinci Resolve or Nuke and look for Keymaster among the effects.
installer.uninstall.text: This removes Keymaster, its Python, the models and the plugins it added. Your keyed clips are kept.
installer.uninstall.confirm: Remove Keymaster and everything it installed from {dir}? Your keyed clips are kept.
installer.uninstall.openfx_left: Removing the OpenFX plugin from {dir} needs administrator rights. Run: {command}
installer.help:
Usage: {program} [options]

  --yes, -y              install without questions, with the defaults
  --components LIST      what to install, separated by commas: core, app, blender, openfx
  --prefix DIR           install folder (default: {prefix})
  --bundled-ffmpeg       download Keymaster's own ffmpeg even if one is installed
  --uninstall            remove Keymaster and everything it installed
  --help                 show this help
